registration_note: The commit containing this file is the authoritative pre-Q2 registration. Its SHA is recorded in the later result evidence; Q2 bytes must not be read before that commit exists.
instrument: Exact NSE F&O option symbol, expiry, strike and CE/PE side
horizon: Verified current official NSE F&O session close to the immediately following official NSE F&O session opening reference

objective_separation.directional: Rank contracts for positive next-opening gross reference movement.
objective_separation.rare_tail: Rank contracts for a gross next-opening reference multiple of at least 3x.
objective_separation.email_or_ui_rule: Keep the two heads labelled separately. A rare-tail rank is not a positive-direction probability and neither score is a calibrated probability or executable fill.

data_plan.frozen_test_access_rule: No Q2 source CSV may be read until this exact registry and candidate implementation are committed. Evaluate each frozen head once, preserve all results, and never retune from Q2.

eligibility.price_range: HghPric > LwPric >= 0 and prior open/close must be within the range.
eligibility.expiry_rule: Expiry must be on or after the following official session.
eligibility.outcome_scoreable_rule: Exact identity exists on following session with positive opening and volume >=1. Following-session volume is outcome availability only and never a selection feature.
eligibility.missing_prior_underlying_or_exact_volume: Use frozen neutral raw value 0 before cross-sectional percentile ranking and record missingness; never use later data.
eligibility.implied_volatility_and_greeks: Zero coverage in archived UDiFF files; excluded, never imputed.

feature_transform: Within-current-session deterministic average percentile ranks in (0,1], followed by a frozen linear logit score. Ranking uses the linear score; it is not exposed as a calibrated probability.

model_family_search.multiple_testing_note: Every inspected model and selection size is retained in the model-selection evidence. Q1 is model-selection data and supplies no untouched-performance claim.

comparators: Identical eligible universe top-10 raw ClsPric/OpnPric momentum
report_for_each_head: mean median and uncapped return distribution hash
paired-session comparator excess and bootstrap interval
q2_frozen_evaluation.directional_head_research_success: At least 100 scoreable selections over at least 60 official sessions, directional accuracy >=65%, positive median gross reference return, positive paired mean excess versus raw momentum, and zero source/identity errors.
q2_frozen_evaluation.rare_tail_head_research_success: At least 100 scoreable selections over at least 60 official sessions, 3x-event precision above raw momentum with positive paired mean excess, and zero source/identity errors.

project_gates.note: Frozen retrospective success does not by itself satisfy forward OOS, fill, cost, Sharpe or real-money readiness gates.
